test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I haven’t seen him _______ last week.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. since .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"since"** is used to refer to a specific point in time in the past, continuing to the present.
 
• The sentence "I haven’t seen him _______ last week" requires a word that indicates a connection between the past (last week) and the present (now).

Correct sentence: *I haven’t seen him **since** last week*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of "since":**

 
 
• It is used to refer to a point in time in the past, marking the start of a period continuing to the present.
 
• **Example:** I have lived here since 2010.
 
 
 
• **Usage of "for":**
 
 
• It is used to indicate a duration of time.
 
• **Example:** I have lived here for 10 years.
